description: This file defines the main dashboard page component for a note-taking application. It manages state for selected notes, creating notes, and sidebar visibility. It uses various imports such as React hooks, custom components, and icons. It handles user authentication, navigation, and rendering of the layout including header, sidebar, and note editor.

methods.name: DashboardPage
methods.description: Main functional component for the dashboard page, managing notes, sidebar, and user authentication.
